CBAM authorisation management in charge of lifecycle management of the CBAM authorisation granted by the NCA to importers or indirect representatives. Communicates the required information of the CBAM Declarant Account to CBAM Authorisation Replication and Validation Services (ARVS), that maintains the information on the CBAM Authorised Declarants to be provided to NCAs and National Customs Competent Administrations (NCCA) in charge of assessing the importer authorisations.
